dedupe_keys.name: dakar photovoltaic electric vehicle rolling resistance and power tests

description: This deposit contains speed, power and rolling-resistance information for a prototype photovoltaic electric vehicle developed for remote energy supply. The Dakar engineering team tests a vehicle with rear-wheel electric motors and varies vehicle mass to study dissipated traction power. Measurements and calculations concern operation on asphalt, with tyre pressure and deformation included in the resistance method. Mendeley publishes an Excel workbook and an LCD-control documentation PDF free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a single experimental vehicle in Dakar, Senegal; repository metadata do not state a calendar span or a repeated driving-cycle sampling interval. The prototype is not representative of a commercial vehicle fleet, and rolling losses alone do not account for every driving resistance. A reviewer-assessed use is checking low-speed electric-vehicle energy components in transport simulations. model-sumo provides a related traffic simulation environment, but parameter translation was not tested. No workbook or PDF was downloaded.
